description: Search the open postings of named companies on Ashby. Ashby publishes no index across its customers, so companies are required. Every filter runs here rather than at the source, and the answer reports how many postings declared nothing about a field it filtered on. Rows carry no description: read one posting with get_job.

companies.description: Company names or board tokens, one to 10. Each costs a request and a whole board, which is why 5 at a time is the comfortable number.

items.description: Company names or Ashby board tokens.

anyOf.description: A list of countries as the board spells them, one to 10 of them.

items.description: A country as the board spells it, as in USA or United Kingdom.

anyOf.description: A country as the board spells it, as in USA or United Kingdom.

currency.description: A three-letter currency code, as in EUR or USD.

anyOf.description: A list of departments as the board spells them, one to 10 of them.

items.description: Departments as the board spells them.

anyOf.description: Departments as the board spells them.
A list of employment types, one to 6 of them.

has_compensation.description: Keeps only postings whose company publishes a pay range.

is_remote.description: Keeps only postings that declare it. Postings recording nothing are counted in undeclared rather than treated as on site.

salary_interval.description: The period salary_min belongs to, 1 YEAR unless named. An hourly amount is never weighed against a yearly floor.

salary_min.description: A floor for the salary component.

search_in.description: Where query is looked for. Descriptions run to thousands of characters each.

anyOf.description: A list of teams as the board spells them, one to 10 of them.

items.description: Teams as the board spells them.

anyOf.description: Teams as the board spells them.
A list of workplace types, one to 4 of them.

name: search_jobs

compensation_summary.description: Null when the company withholds its pay ranges, which is never zero.

is_listed.description: False marks a posting Ashby serves by direct link alone rather than on the board.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 with the offset Ashby publishes.

workplace_type.description: Null when the company records none, which is never the same as on site.

read.description: Postings the board holds, before the filters applied here. Null when nothing was read, since zero would read as a board with nothing on it.

status.description: A company read, one whose token was not found, one publishing nothing and one that failed are four different answers.

returned.description: Postings in this answer, after limit and offset.

total_on_board.description: Postings the boards read hold, all of them.

undeclared.description: Postings a criterion could say nothing about, counted per field. A posting that records no workplace is not a posting on site.

title: Search postings at named companies
